title: The Cavalry Leap
setup: Chariots and cavalry, still moving the way they moved fifteen centuries ago.
hint: The black king has one square to run to. Which leap checks it and attacks the rook at the same time?
explanation:
## The Idea

A knight's check cannot be blocked: the knight never crosses the squares in between, so there is nothing to put in the way.

{{Nf7+}} touches h8 and d8 in the same move. Black's only legal reply is {{Kg8}}, and {{Nxd8}} collects the rook, which never saw the check coming: f7 is on neither its rank nor its file.

When the enemy king is short of squares, look for the knight square that touches the king and something valuable at once.
